reports.title: S24+ and S24 Ultra battery capacities surfaced
reports.summary: A report said the S24+ could receive a larger battery than its predecessor, with the Ultra also appearing in the early capacity leak.

reports.title: CAD renders suggested a familiar S24 family design
reports.summary: Leaked CAD imagery showed the Galaxy S24 family retaining a familiar overall design, with changes to details rather than a radical redesign.

reports.title: Only one S24 model was tipped for a RAM increase
reports.summary: A leak suggested that one Galaxy S24 variant, not the Ultra, would receive a RAM boost, making the family configuration differences part of the speculation.

reports.title: Promo images leaked the S24 family colors and titanium frame
reports.summary: Leaked promotional material was reported to show launch colors for the S24 family and a titanium frame for the top model.

reports.title: A complete S24 family specification list appeared
reports.summary: A late leak claimed to list the Galaxy S24, S24+ and S24 Ultra specifications and the regional Snapdragon-versus-Exynos distribution.
